text: Im so sorry to bother you, it might be nothing. My son is 9 and he's had a runny blocked nose and been sneezing all day. Tonight I noticed some little dark spots on him. He has dark skin so its hard to see on his arms, so I looked on his palms and the bottoms of his feet and inside his bottom eyelid, and there are tiny red-purpley dots there. I pressed a glass on his hand like they say and they dont go away when I press. Sorry I dont know if im overreacting, what should I do
